scope: Standing Taganrog Chekhov Drama Theatre at 90 Petrovskaya Street, its cream two-storey historic entrance, lower flanking bays, auditorium envelope and red-brick rear stage blocks.

originalReview.notes: The exact street view shows the plain pediment, five upper windows, dividing pilasters and sill bands, green iron entrance canopy, wood doors, broad steps and rear red brick stage house.

quallaSearch.notes: Exact Qualla creator-dedicated 2007 exterior, matched against the original Commons record. The unrelated Qualla images were excluded.
